rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'A plane equation only needs the normal vector' ✅ A plane requires *both* a normal vector (direction) *and* at least one point it passes through.  ·  ❌ 'The coefficients A, B, C in Ax + By + Cz + D = 0 are arbitrary' ✅ The coefficients (A, B, C) represent the components of the normal vector to the plane.
